# FULL AIRCRAFT DATABASE

Read-only inventory. Game/patch files were not modified.
Sources: mod.z, DONOR_ART, DONOR_INI, art_data, _SPEC_ART_ONE, _SPEC_DATA_ONE,
Specter_Data, Data.zip, SPECTER FINAL, Peace Mission, New folder (TEOD),
workspace overlay INI, and local GitHub release BIG packs.

If the same aircraft exists in multiple patches, it is listed under every patch.
Primary archives use the full TYPE/ART/DATA block. Other GitHub packs use an indented copy of the same fields.
A merged master index by country is first; per-patch listings follow; a cross-reference is at the end.

- Read-only. No INI/ART/CommandSet files were modified.
- Mod.z is a 29-volume zip (mod.z01-mod.z28 + mod.zip). It has World Builder molds, not playable W3D aircraft meshes.
- DONOR_Art.part001-069.rar listed by filename (W3D/DDS/TGA).
- art_data.part*.rar contains packed _SPEC_ART_ONE.big and _SPEC_DATA_ONE.big.
- New folder (TEOD) contains NVH20.W3D + H-20.dds (real H-20 flying-wing mesh).
- GitHub release china-h20 is the latest packed SPEC pair that includes China H-20.
- Damage/LOD variants (_D/_R/_K) are grouped under the parent aircraft name.
- Projectiles, missiles, air-defense guns, bushes, and artillery were excluded.
